title: Malicious code in evt-dispatcher (npm)
description: The npm package 'evt-dispatcher' contains malicious native code that executes automatically when the package is required. It loads a platform-specific native addon that decodes and runs an opaque payload from a large sibling file. The malicious code includes evasion techniques to avoid detection in CI environments, containers, and debugging tools, activating only on developer workstations. This behavior is unrelated to the package's advertised event-emitter functionality.
